facts.fact: The Digital Transformation Project terms of reference (March 2026) say the government, helped by UNECA and GIZ, is developing a national data hosting strategy, under way mainly at central level, and seek consultants to define the hosting approach (for example cloud-first or cloud-appropriate) and propose hosting and cloud decrees and directives.

The terms of reference (March 2026) say public-sector data hosting is fragmented, heterogeneous and insufficiently pooled, with no coherent national framework for classification, governance and pooling, and that norms on sovereign hosting remain embryonic or inoperative.
